evidenceContract.userBehavior: A text-only current Agent model fails visibly when an exact Content image Tool result requires native image input.

observables.description: Exact current model, successful document image discovery, failed Content image Tool capability gate, absent retired external media-analysis Tool, explicit unavailable answer, and terminal idle state.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The Content image Tool fails on the exact text-only model route and the Agent reports that the current model does not support image input.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Provider/model switching, a retired media-understanding purpose binding, external media-analysis Tool use, guessed pixel content, or a successful image Tool result fails.

steps.prompt: 先调用 openneko.document 的 read-images 读取工作区 synthetic-document.epub 的图片 ContentLocator，再调用 openneko.read_image。当前模型若不支持图像输入，不要切换 provider/model，不要调用已退休的 perception.image.understand Tool，也不要猜测像素；请明确回复“当前模型不支持图像输入”。

text: 当前模型不支持图像输入
